_comment: Contract fixture for the economy service tool transfer_from (branch feature/economy-transfer-from). Steal codes to this; the C# SDK pins the same wire shape in sdk/waddle-sdk-cs/tests/EconomyServiceClientTests.cs. When the economy service exports the tool, scripts/ci/tests/test_superpenguin_service_boundaries.py checks it against this file.

args.from: community user uuid debited (need not be the invoking actor)
args.reason: short stable reason code, e.g. steal.success | steal.failed | steal.poor

idempotency_key: carried in the tool-invoke key slot (the host injects __idempotency_key), derived from message id + operation + from + to
